findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The sanitizer concentration in the sanitizer bottle was recorded at less than 100ppm QUAT. PIC corrected this by increasing the concentration of the sanitizer to 200ppm QUAT. Ensure that test strips are utilized in the facility when creating the sanitizer to ensure its efficacy. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The shelving in the dry storage room are observed to have bare wood where the food is stored. This was pointed out to the PIC and a solution of a coat of paint on the bare wood. Ensure all bare wood is sealed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Person in charge is unsure of how dishware is sanitized when it is not run through the dish machine and it is manually washed, rinsed and sanitized instead. Facility has sanitizer prepared in a spray bottle for food contact surfaces, but this is not sufficient for sanitizing of dishware and is used for counters and tables. A residential dishwasher is available, but it is reported that this is not always used as they mostly use disposable plates and utensils. Provide a sanitizer such as Sani Tabs, which use the same test strip as the sanitizer in the spray bottle. PIC states they will ensure that all dishware and utensils are run through the dish machine and that they will verify that maximum registering thermometer reaches 160F each cycle to correct this violation.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11  (P) After cleaning, utensils must be sanitized before use. Reference 4-702.11.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed foods in the reach in cooler in the emergency shelter kitchen to be probed at internal temperatures between 47-50F. All potentially hazardous foods out of temperature were discarded during the inspection. This included: a pan of taco meat, a pan of shredded chicken, a half a pan of rice, 2 gallons of milk, a container of sour cream, 3lbs cheese slices, shredded cheese, cut lettuce, 3 bottles ranch dressing, 1 bottle italian dressing, and a half a gallon of lemonade. Maintain cold foods at internal temperatures of 41F or below at all times.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the restrooms in the lobby to not have soap or paper towels available. These restrooms do not have self closers either. There is one restroom in the basement without a covered trash can. Provides soap, paper towels and covered waste cans to each restroom. Make sure that restrooms near the kitchens and in the lobby have self closers on the doors.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.
